run_detection_on_images: run object detection on a list of input images using CenterNet2 and save visualized outputs
run_detection_on_webcam: run real-time object detection on webcam feed using CenterNet2 with OpenCV display
run_detection_on_video: run object detection on a video file and optionally save the annotated output video
setup_cfg_merge_config: setup and merge a Detectron2 config from a YAML file with command-line overrides
get_parser_args: get an argparse parser with arguments for config file, input, output, and confidence threshold
